chapters.title: The Reception
chapters.content: Ada stood at the edge of the reception, a glass of wine warming untouched in her hand, and watched the dancers turn under the lanterns. Bram came in late, as he always did, and crossed the floor toward her. His jaw was tight and he did not smile, and she guessed from the set of his shoulders that the meeting had gone badly. He stopped a careful arm's length away. Across the room, Bram secretly wished he had never agreed to come to the wedding at all. Ada offered him the wine she had not drunk. He took it without a word and looked out at the dancers, frowning, and for a long moment neither of them said anything at all while the music carried on.
